text.tspan: derived-credit
Close acquisition directory, drain read leases,
acquire exact Done receipt, retire root
registration, then release session after last
restoration debt
execution-owner
Reserve no-GC stable slot and protect input under
caller root fence before any marker allocation;
failure retains caller ownership
root-publication
Publish immutable descriptor only after VM-wide
scanned mutable root slots are registered; nonzero
processor cannot assume current RC list provides
coverage
storage-commit
VM cleanup excludes live guards, exported
continuation handles and invocation leases; storage
and old-roster duties remain parent obligations
marker-acquire
Reload relocated proc from registered root; publish
fully initialized marker with one still reference
without another safepoint; allocation failure owns
no marker
abnormal-takeover
Normal tail and admitted exceptional custodian
compete for same generation-aware cleanup state;
winner pins session and owns nonabandonable cleanup
segment
single-drop
Invalidate marker then decrement exactly one owned
still reference; no reentry, GC, native throw or
executor takeover in this segment
completion-receipt
Publish Done only after cleanup and restoration
complete; query lost acknowledgement using exact
activation and settlement identities; do not replay
kill

g.text: SysML -> ASCENT -> QNT / Lean; source + platform OPEN

text.tspan: complete-marker-custody
Safety is conditional on no-abandonment cleanup and
complete exceptional landing coverage
registration-sharing
Shared support saves setup duplication only;
O(A+H+I+R+T) metadata and retained unresolved roots
remain
retire-duplicate-tail-policy
Old kill sites retire only after every path routes
through same marker token; no double accounting
modern-c-net-benefit
Positive work balance requires actually removed
repeated support or setup cost to exceed added checks;
Zig-specific savings unproved
